description: This Java class 'BooleanConceptChangeSet' defines a custom Liquibase change for managing boolean concepts within the OpenMRS database. It creates or finds true/false concepts, updates existing observations to use these concepts, and sets global properties accordingly.

classes.name: BooleanConceptChangeSet
classes.description: A custom Liquibase change class that manages the creation of boolean concepts and updates observations accordingly in the OpenMRS database.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that performs the creation or retrieval of true/false concepts, sets global properties, and updates existing observations to use the new concepts.

methods.name: findConceptByName
methods.description: Searches for an existing concept ID by name across multiple locales.

methods.name: createConcept
methods.description: Creates a new concept in the database with specified localized names.

methods.name: changeObs
methods.description: Updates observation records to set their value_coded to the true or false concept, based on their current numeric value.

methods.name: createGlobalProperties
methods.description: Inserts global properties for true and false concepts into the database.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement expected to return a single integer result.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the operation completed successfully.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Setter for resource accessor, not used in this implementation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup method, not used in this implementation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the database before executing changes; here it always returns empty errors.
